answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a ferrous-backed bond before it can trade, with the stake slashed if peers prove fake behaviour. Like a vine that only grows from one rooted stem, each stake is tied to one verified history, so creating thousands of fake agents means funding thousands of separate stakes. A lotus-like public reputation score then rises only with completed, attested work, making Sybil farming expensive, slow, and easy to prune when fraud is found.
